description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a glowing violet haven light bolt streaking forward; a phoenix-shaped flame emblem with wide spread fiery wings; a towering dark blue tsunami wave curling high; a huge green storm sphere ringed by spinning white blades; a full ring of tall jagged ice crystals bursting outward; a huge stone golem fist bursting up from cracked ground; a bold silver swoosh curving sharply sideways in a quick dodge; a violet crystal orb inside a counter-clockwise reset arrow; two small elemental orbs, red and blue, colliding in a bright spark. Color theme: mixed set: each icon keeps its own element colour (fire orange, water blue, wind green, ice cyan, earth brown, haven violet), shared gold rim highlights. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
